svg.text: M04 · manual writer and aligned catches
Machining coordinate sheet · dimensions in mm · nominal design, no fabricated validation
A Global Y/Z section · force line X = 460, Z = 92
Global Y stations; Z increases upward. Parked knob reaches Y−140. Commercial outlines are envelopes.
B Captive lead: opposed axial bearings
Journal Ø5.990–5.998; Ø6.4 bore; Ø12.03 wells.
Screw rotates; housing washers and carriage do not.
C Cell stud and spherical end · front
Cell blind thread: M3 × 0.5, maximum depth 2.8.
Rear mirrors this: face 5.0 / mouth −0.4 / pin −18.9.
D Central catches at the rear port · all axes X460, Z92
Initial tips: Y106.70 / Y113.30. Conditional 0.55 gaps: Y106.45 / Y113.55.
Hollow M8 × 0.5 stops: Ø3.5 bore for Ø3 water rod; post tap drill Ø7.5. Qualify installed clearance.
Catches are overtravel stops; any contact ends the run. They do not enforce the ±5 N force limit.
No claim of impact rating, side-load allowance, calibration or completed physical operation.
E Turning stations and release checks
Ø3; clamp ball through two 2.1 spacers
Purchased-part internal geometry is governed by EZO F6-12M, FUTEK FI1041-G and igus KBRM-03 source drawings.
This section sheet accompanies the complete cut/drill table and assembly notes; it is not a standalone operating authorization.
